name: spi_wire
description: The core's SPI library at 4 MHz, mode 0, to a 25LC040 (CS on D10): WREN sets its latch, WRITE of six bytes, RDSR polled through its 5 ms write cycle, READ returns them; 589 bytes of 16 SCK edges each, through D13's L LED. The Wire library to a 24C02 at 0x50 (4.7 kOhm pull-ups on A4 and A5): a page write, address-only writes NACKed through its write cycle, a write without STOP then requestFrom after a repeated START (twi.c's TWWC loop), the same at 400 kHz, and 0x51 answered by nobody (endTransmission's 2); 1146 SCL edges.

expect.contains: spi: status 02 after WREN, write cycle over after 284 polls, read Uno328

wire: page write 0
wire: ready again after 35 NACKs
wire: random read at 100 kHz 0 4 ire!
wire: random read at 400 kHz 0 5 Wire!
wire: 0x51 2
done
